mcqs.question: National Energy Conservation Day 2025 was observed on which date?
mcqs.explanation: National Energy Conservation Day 2025 was observed on 14 December 2025. The other dates relate to the establishment of BEE and the launch of other energy-related initiatives, not to National Energy Conservation Day 2025.

mcqs.question:
Assertion (A): The Bureau of Energy Efficiency is a statutory body established on 1 March 2002.
Reason (R): It was established under the Energy Conservation Act, 2001.
options: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
mcqs.explanation: Both the Assertion and the Reason are true. BEE became a statutory body on 1 March 2002 under the Energy Conservation Act, 2001, and the Act provides the legal basis for its establishment.

mcqs.question:
With reference to the initiatives of the Bureau of Energy Efficiency, consider the following statements:
1. Standards and Labeling is a BEE initiative.
2. Demand Side Management is a BEE initiative.
3. The Perform, Achieve and Trade mechanism was replaced by the Carbon Credit Trading Scheme in 2023.
mcqs.explanation: All three statements are correct. BEE initiatives include Standards and Labeling and Demand Side Management, while PAT was replaced by the Carbon Credit Trading Scheme in 2023. Therefore, the alternatives omitting statement 3 are incorrect.

mcqs.question: Which one of the following statements regarding the BEE star label is incorrect?
options: It is found on ceiling fans.
It is found on electric geysers.
It is found on tubular fluorescent lamps.
It is found on solar water pumps.
mcqs.explanation: The incorrect statement is that the BEE star label is found on solar water pumps. The cited appliances carrying the label are ceiling fans, electric geysers and tubular fluorescent lamps.

mcqs.question:
Match List-I with List-II regarding energy and climate-related schemes:

List-I
(a) PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana
(b) National Green Hydrogen Mission
(c) Renewable Consumption Obligation
(d) Production Linked Incentive scheme

List-II
(i) 14 sectors, with incentives for 4–6 years
(ii) February 2024; 1 crore households; up to 300 units of free electricity per month
(iii) January 2023; ₹19,744 crore; 5 MMT per year by 2030
(iv) Formerly RPO; 29.91% in FY25 rising to 43.33% in FY30
mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are a-ii, b-iii, c-iv and d-i. PM Surya Ghar is linked with February 2024 and 1 crore households; the Green Hydrogen Mission with January 2023 and ₹19,744 crore; the Renewable Consumption Obligation with the FY25–FY30 percentages; and PLI with 14 sectors and 4–6-year incentives. The other codes interchange these scheme features.
